problem: The lamina $D={(x,y)\,:\,0\le x\le 3y,\,0\le y\le 1}$ has the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)=5xy.$ Find the moment of the lamina about the $y$-axis.
worked_solution:
The moment of a lamina $D$ with the mass density function $\lambda (x,y)$ about the $y$-axis is given by

$$
{M}_{y}={∬}_{D}x\,\lambda (x,y)\,\text{d}A.
$$

In our case, $D$ is represented as a type II plane region and $\lambda (x,y)=5xy.$ 

Therefore, the moment is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{y} & ={∬}_{D}x\cdot 5xy\,\text{d}A \\  & ={∬}_{D}5{x}^{2}y\,\text{d}A \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{3y}5{x}^{2}y\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}5y{\int }_{0}^{3y}{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}5y{[\frac{{x}^{3}}{3}]}_{x=0}^{x=3y}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}5y(9{y}^{3}-0)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}45{y}^{4}\,\text{d}y \\  & =[9{y}^{5}]_{y=0}^{y=1} \\  & =9.\end{aligned}
$$
